Subject: Serious Complaint Regarding Staff Misconduct and Unprofessional Behavior

I am a regular customer at your petrol pump and have always preferred your outlet for fueling my vehicle. However, my recent experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.
Yesterday, when I came to refill my vehicle, the person handling the fuel pump was neither wearing a proper uniform nor displaying an identity card. This itself raises serious concerns about staff authenticity and management supervision.
While fueling, the amount stopped at ₹399.44. I politely requested him to make it ₹400. He said it would go to ₹402, and I clearly agreed to pay that amount. Instead of responding professionally, he rudely replied, “Who will give the change? Will you give me?” He repeatedly asked whether I had come for the first time to fuel my vehicle and kept murmuring in a disrespectful tone. His behavior was arrogant, insulting, and completely unacceptable.
This kind of attitude is not expected from staff representing a petroleum outlet. Customer service requires basic courtesy and professionalism, which were clearly missing.
If staff cannot behave properly with customers, it reflects serious mismanagement. I strongly urge you to:
Ensure all staff wear proper uniforms and identity cards.
Provide proper customer service training.
Take strict action against such misconduct.
Incidents like this damage your outlet’s reputation. If corrective action is not taken, I will be compelled to avoid your petrol pump in the future and advise others to do the same.
I expect a prompt response and necessary action.
Sincerely,
Nikesh Chavan

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the good fortune of visiting a petrol pump recently that was excellent by every parameter—service, hygiene, and overall customer experience. On a high-density highway stretch, this fuel pump is a daily commuter's and long-distance traveler's savior. My experience was truly eye-opening, and here is an in-depth review on multiple parameters:

Location & Accessibility:
The petrol pump is well-placed on the highway, easily accessible to all vehicles—two-wheelers, four-wheelers, and even big trucks. There is sufficient space to drive in, out, and about without much bother, even at busy times of the day. Signboards guiding you to the pump are well-marked from afar so you won't miss the turn.

Fuel Quality & Availability:
Fuel quality is perhaps the most important aspect of any petrol outlet, and this filling station does not disappoint in that area. Both petrol and diesel are provided on a regular basis, and they also provide premium fuel variants such as XP95 and Power diesel. I observed a fuel quality checking board with daily calibration reports, which instils confidence in their product. My experience was enhanced engine performance and mileage, which shows clean and contamination-free fuel.

Staff & Service:
Staff here are polite, well-dressed in their uniforms, and professionally courteous. They welcomed me with a smile, politely inquired about the fuel needed, and even cleaned the windshield and checked the air pressure for free. Billing was hassle-free—cash and digital payments (UPI, cards, wallets) were accepted, and an instant-printed receipt was handed over. The attendants did not insist on additional services, which made the experience genuine and respectful.

Cleanliness & Amenities:
What actually impressed me was the premises' cleanliness. The premises were free from litter, the ground was not oily with oil spills, and the restrooms were surprisingly clean. A small convenience store was annexed, with snacks, cold beverages, basic car accessories, and travel necessities. There's also an RO water dispenser, which is a godsend on long trips.

Other Facilities:
The air-filling point was in good working condition and could be used for free, complete with tyre pressure and nitrogen top-up. There is also a dedicated lane for commercial trucks and a small service bay for simple vehicle checkups such as oil top-off and battery tests. CCTV cameras were placed throughout the grounds, providing extra security and transparency.

Weaknesses:
One thing I would criticize, if I must, is the limited seating area. For tourists who simply wish to take a brief respite, a shaded sitting area would have been perfect. And at times of peak traffic, the line tends to accumulate, and even if staff attempt to control it efficiently, it takes a little longer than anticipated.

Final Verdict:
Overall, this petrol pump is a highly recommended stop for anyone seeking quick refueling, courteous service, and clean surroundings. It reflects professionalism and customer care, which makes it stand out among many others. I’ll definitely be returning here for my future refueling needs.
